title: Template initialization generator
description: Record and apply validated workspace initialization choices

displayName.description: Human-readable application name; defaults from the slug

packageScope.description: Lowercase npm package scope such as @acme
packageScope.x-prompt: What npm package scope should the workspace use?

repositoryOwner.description: GitHub user or organization that owns the generated repository
repositoryOwner.x-prompt: Which GitHub user or organization owns the repository?

codeowners.description: Comma-separated @users, @org/teams, or email CODEOWNERS; defaults to the repository owner

applications.description: Comma-separated selection from web, api, and worker

databaseName.description: PostgreSQL database name; defaults from the application slug

authentication.description: Authentication profile; defaults to development when api is selected and none otherwise

workerTransport.description: Worker delivery transport; defaults to postgres when worker is selected and none otherwise

ai.description: Select optional AI capabilities; requires web and api
